about_the_game:
Supersonic Fight is a modern combat flight game focused on authentic jet handling and cinematic, story-driven missions. Fly high-stakes battles over San Francisco where timing, precision, and decisive strikes matter. Every mission is carefully briefed, every outcome has consequences, and every success pushes the story forward.

Story

For over three decades, the USS Enterprise (CVN-65) has operated off the coast of San Francisco, its carrier air wing responsible for defending the city's airspace. With funding cut and defenses weakened, a long-waiting enemy finally makes its move. You take your place in the cockpit: outnumbered, outpaced, and under pressure.

Key Features

Story-Driven Single-Player Campaign

Fly a full narrative campaign of challenging combat missions. Get to know your squadron, earn the trust of your commanding officer, and face an enemy that grows more dangerous as the story unfolds.

Purposeful Mission Design

Escort, intercept, defend, and strike targets in missions where timing and positioning are just as important as firepower. Arrive early, late, or exactly on time, and feel the difference.

Multiplayer Combat Modes

Test your skills against other pilots in Dogfight, Team Dogfight, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Defend-and-Attack, and VIP modes.

Free Flight Mode

Fly without objectives or constraints. Choose an aircraft, climb into the stratosphere or skim the terrain, and experience the freedom of flying, accompanied by an original atmospheric soundtrack.

HOTAS Support

Fly using your preferred flight stick and throttle setup with full HOTAS support, with or without VR.

Virtual Reality (Optional)

Virtual reality support adds full head tracking and interactive cockpit controls, allowing players to combine traditional inputs with VR controllers.

Aircraft Selection

Pilot a diverse roster of modern and iconic military aircraft, from cutting-edge fighters to legendary combat aircraft.

Training & Tutorials

Selectable training scenarios cover all core aspects of flight and combat, from basic handling to advanced maneuvers, weapons employment, evasion, and countermeasures.

Customization & Steam Workshop

Create custom aircraft liveries using the in-game editor, then share them with the community via Steam Workshop.

80s-Inspired Soundtrack

An original soundtrack composed by Bert “D4XX” Bruggemann, inspired by classic 1980s action cinema.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: VR Supported
  • Additional Notes: Please note: these specs will change as development progresses.
